claim: On hillstrom, the agent is as good as the best simple policy (send to none / send to all / segment rule, chosen on train): the Holm-Bonferroni-corrected lower bound of (agent minus best simple policy), on test, is above minus 2% of that policy's DR value. The family is every agent-versus-policy comparison of all four dev datasets.
